transcript.rail.tickUnloaded: Turn {round} (not loaded yet; click to load it): {prompt}

transcript.entry.renderFailed: This row could not be displayed: {message}
transcript.foot.durationTip: {duration} (from this message to the last write in the turn, including tool calls and reasoning)
transcript.foot.copy: Copy the original text of this reply
transcript.foot.fork: Fork a new session from this message
transcript.foot.usageTip: Sum of prompt and completion tokens across every model request in this turn (as reported by the host)

transcript.fold.tipAborted: This turn was interrupted; the process stays expanded
transcript.fold.tipError: This turn failed; the process stays expanded
transcript.fold.tipEmpty: This turn has no process content to fold
transcript.fold.tipCollapse: Collapse this turn's process (reasoning and tool calls)
transcript.fold.tipExpand: Expand this turn's process (reasoning and tool calls)
transcript.think.label: Thinking
transcript.tool.mismatchMissing: old is not in the current file
transcript.tool.traceTip: See when this call ran and how long it took, on the trace page
transcript.tool.intendedFallback: Cannot read the current file; the diff below is inferred from the arguments
transcript.tool.intendedMissing: old does not exist in the file; running this will fail
transcript.tool.intendedAmbiguous: old matches several places; running this will fail
transcript.tool.intendedIdentical: Both sides are identical; nothing will change.

transcript.tool.moreTip: {count} more result lines; open to see all
transcript.tool.openPatchTip: {path} (view this change in the side panel)
